value.name: accepts her reasoning
value.description: The man agrees that Asha's reason for trusting someone is the better one.
evidence: "That is the better reason," Asha said.

value.name: plans to sell possessions
value.description: He says he will sell some things and manage with the money his mother left him, promising to be careful.
evidence: "I am going to need to sell some things," he said. "My mother left me money. It is enough to handle what I have to handle if I am careful. I am going to be careful."

value.name: negotiates inheritance items
value.description: He explains that Lucia has allowed him to keep some items from the house and that they are still negotiating over what he will retain.
evidence: "Lucia has said I can keep some things from the house. The books. The desk. The watch that was Dad's. She said I should have the chair Mom sat in. I told her no. She said yes. We are still negotiating."
"You will probably keep negotiating for a long time."

value.name: questions burned note silence
value.description: He confronts Asha about the burned note and asks why she has not asked for it in writing or reported it.
evidence: "Asha. The note. The one I burned. I told you about that in front of witnesses. You have not asked me to put it in writing. You have not, as far as I can tell, reported it to anyone."

value.name: explains decision not to report
value.description: Asha explains that the codicil has already been filed, the harm has been undone, and she is choosing not to take away his second chance.
evidence: "Because the codicil is filed," she said. "Because the harm I would prevent by reporting it has already been undone by the document itself being found. Because your mother trusted, I think, that you would have a second chance, and I am not going to be the one who takes that from her."

value.name: rejects duty to protect him
value.description: He tells Asha that protecting him is not her job, and she agrees while admitting she is stepping outside her role.
evidence: "No," she said. "It is not. I am stepping a little outside of it."

value.name: reveals grief over mother's death
value.description: Asha begins explaining that her choice is shaped by her own experience of losing her mother and emptying her apartment alone.
